description: NSW Toll Road Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport for NSW. This is a link to the NSW Toll Road Data website. The datasets on this website contain traffic data for the following toll roads in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia that are wholly or partly owned by Transurban: Cross City Tunnel (CCT) Hills M2 (M2) Lane Cove Tunnel/Military Road E-Ramp (LCT) M1 Eastern Distributor (ED) ... Coverage: Transport for NSW. The portal files it under the publisher Transport for NSW. Its tags are Cross city tunnel, Eastern Distributor, M1, M2, M4. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-06-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
